A '''sonic disruptor''' was a [[Disruptor/Legends|disruptor weapon]] used in the years following the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].

==Description==
One of the most violent [[Sonic weapon/Legends|sonic weapons]] on the market, the sonic disruptor was outlawed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], even for use against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. The sonic disruptor disintegrated its target, leaving few traces of a victim behind. Personal defenses such as [[Personal energy shield/Legends|energy shields]] were no match for this weapon; even a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] could not deflect sonic damage with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" /> Due to the massive energy requirements, the disruptor needed a few seconds to cool down between shots.

==History==
This weapon was carried by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunting]] brothers [[Dob Moomo|Dob]] and [[Del Moomo]].<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' video game, the sonic disruptor was a rifle. But in the more recent ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]'', it is classified as a pistol.
